recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a woman with voluminous wavy hair wearing a gold sequined dress, set against a textured, warm golden background filled with bokeh light particles and star-shaped lens flares. The typography is layered over the lower third, featuring a clean sans-serif for the name and a textured, metallic treatment for the title.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's sequined texture mirroring the background bokeh particles
Warm monochromatic gold palette unifying subject and environment
Geometric typography providing a structural anchor to the soft, ethereal background
High-key lighting on the face contrasting with the dense texture of the hair and dress
coreInvariants: Dense overlay of light particles and starburst flares
Sequined textile texture on the primary garment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale metallic title in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the hair down to the sequined dress, and settles on the bold typography at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with texture, light effects, and hair volume.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow-orange spectrum with high value contrast in the glitter effects.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the primary name
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title text features a thick, rounded stroke with a gold sequin texture fill
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a light, airy geometric sans for the name and a heavy, textured display face for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, modern geometric skeleton of the name text.
Provides the necessary circular geometry for the 'O' and 'G'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a woman with voluminous wavy brown hair wearing a gold sequined dress. The background is a warm, textured gold with heavy bokeh light particles and scattered starburst lens flares. Lighting is soft and frontal on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a geometric sans-serif name in white across the lower third with wide tracking. Below it, in the bottom right, add a large, bold, rounded title word with a gold sequin texture fill and a subtle 3D bevel effect.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm gold and bronze?
Are there visible starburst flares and bokeh circles?
Is the name text clean and geometric?
Does the title text have a sequined texture?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold color grading
Scale of the sequin texture in the title
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting between subject and background
Ensure typography is legible against the busy texture
Verify the 'gold' texture looks metallic rather than yellow
Confirm the lens flares do not obscure the face
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered high-glamour portrait with a monochromatic warm color grade, heavy particle overlays, and a two-tier geometric typographic layout where the bottom tier uses a material-based texture fill.
